decisions.reason: This adjustable cardboard shelf display quarter pallet is very close to our core display know-how, so our existing design, production and R&D capabilities give us strong ability to refine and commercialise it further.

The pegboard-back cardboard shelf display fits directly within our established product and process base, making it a product we can learn about quickly and improve with low additional knowledge costs.
This cardboard shelf display quarter pallet is highly related to our existing offer, so absorptive capacity is high and there is little reason to withdraw it after only an initial market period.

The eighth-pallet cardboard display extends our core display range in a familiar format, allowing us to use existing customer insight, manufacturing routines and in-house development to strengthen it.

Although the wooden display pallet is somewhat less central than cardboard formats, it still builds on our display-design and fulfilment strengths and is close enough to justify continued development rather than exit.

This cardboard quarter-pallet display for media products remains close to our established capabilities and offers a targeted application where our existing retail-display knowledge can be effectively applied and improved.
